THE_ARCHITECT.talk.CAN_AO.0-0.ancient: Another challenger reaches the end. Can Ao, your flame has burned through time itself.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.CAN_AO.0-1.char: My empire is not behind me. It is wherever my blade falls.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.CAN_AO.0-2.ancient: Go. Let the stars and the moon remember your name.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.CAN_AO.1-0.ancient: You return, victor. Your name is etched here now.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.CAN_AO.1-1.char: Once more, the crown is mine.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.CAN_AO.2-1.char: The dynasty is eternal. The war goes on.
